trigger: The R10F forward authority sequence ends with declaring a distinct held-out finite decision graph only after a positive development route ghost. The R10J pair c54720f0 at 0602e0f4 is that positive ghost, verified by retained post-exposure replays.
question: Under the exact frozen R10J route, DLL, task criteria and readers, do all six held-out cells (three previously unobserved prefix-phase fixtures times both fresh roles) complete the finite four-foot task and settled stop?

population.seed_to_phase_rule: common gait phase = seed mod 360 for every limb in the walking prefix; the development seed 40200 gives phase 240 and was the only fixture ever opened
population.seed_scope: Exact enumeration of three adjacent previously unobserved prefix phase fixtures; canonical prone initializer unchanged.

required_artifacts.content: Transitive source closure of the R10J route: every GDScript, Rust, Python, PowerShell and JSON path the worker, launcher, readers and evaluators load, with exact digests at the freeze commit. Precedent: sdk/qsdk_r05e_dependency_manifest_v1.json.

Frozen population (seeds, offsets, roles), the exact R10J v2 candidate and route contract digests, the unchanged V50 DLL digest, the finite task predicates (four planned cycles, 120-command stop, settled tail, whole-envelope limits) and the acceptance conjunction, written before any held-out physics. Precedent: sdk/qsdk_r05e_exact_finite_morphology_preregistration.json.

A single-use wrapper that requires clean source equal to live main, runs the complete 167-check R10J gate plus held-out-specific controls, and retains a closure-only qualification record. Precedent: sdk/qsdk_r05e_zero_world_qualification.ps1.

A single-use authority file committed alone as an authority-only child of the qualification commit: freeze commit, qualification closure digest and git blob, seeds and seed digests, worker resource, per-cell and campaign world and solver-step ceilings, one campaign attempt. Precedent: sdk/qsdk_r05e_exact_finite_execution_authority.json.
Validates the three-commit freeze / qualification-only / authority-only graph and rejects content and repository mutations. Precedent: tests/test_qsdk_r05e_execution_authority_contract.ps1.

Extends the development smoke launcher: accepts the authority path instead of the development seed, launches six children (three seeds times two roles) under the R10J v2 candidate through the same isolated worker, retains every child, runs the launcher replay and the independent audit on each, never replaces or retries a cell. The worker must accept a declared held-out seed only when the authority envelope names it; today it refuses any seed other than 40200 by construction.

Recomputes every retained cell: readiness, native command bytes, finite walking measurement, settled tail and envelope limits, then the six-cell conjunction. Precedent: sdk/audit_qsdk_r05e_exact_finite_morphology_result.ps1.

Immutable closure binding the retained tree manifest and the finite decision; permanent test that reconstructs it. Precedent: sdk/qsdk_r05e_exact_finite_morphology_physical_closure_v1.json and tests/test_qsdk_r05e_physical_closure.ps1.

A decision record in the QSDK-R24D173 style binding six immutable consumed valid complete positive cells, then the release contract QSDK-R10 proof and the support matrix updated to it; the readiness compiler then reports SDK1 15/20 and full program 15/25.

worker_change_required.seed_acceptance: tests/test_sdk_qsdk_r10f_continuous_passive_recovery_worker.gd refuses configured_seed != DEVELOPMENT_SEED; the held-out runner needs an authority-bound seed set (seed, label, digest) validated against the single-use authority envelope, with the development refusal preserved for every non-authorized launch.
worker_change_required.launcher_change: sdk/run_development_recovery_smoke.ps1 declares seed=40200 in its declaration; the held-out declaration must carry the authorized seed per child and refuse mixed or repeated seeds.

zero_world_controls_required: three-role controls: no-kick ramp-to-hold, no-kick hold-to-walk, kicked recovery-to-walk each exercised through the real worker hooks and cold readers
authority envelope refusals: wrong seed, reused seed, consumed authority, drifted freeze, drifted qualification closure, mixed candidates
declared_risks: V50 canonical initial support memory targets neutral joints; the hold start transient was survived at phase 240 and is unmeasured at phases 241 to 243.
The no-kick hold reached readiness at hold command 182 of 240 at phase 240; the margin at other phases is unknown.
One campaign attempt: a single failed or infrastructure-invalid cell consumes the R10J held-out population.
estimate: The R05E chain that flipped QSDK-R05 needed about 4,600 lines of PowerShell plus GDScript and Python across seven commits; the R10J chain reuses the smoke launcher, worker and readers but adds the six-cell runner, the seed authority and the auditor. This is days of zero-world work before the single physical attempt.
